PM Modi inaugurates India's first integrated refinery-petrochemical complex

Prime Minister Narendra Modi has inaugurated the country's first greenfield integrated refinery-cum-petrochemical complex in Rajasthan's Balotra district. The project is described as a significant milestone for India's energy sector and industrial development, aiming to bolster energy security. The inauguration took place at Pachpadra.
